item.title: ACADEMIC VISIT
item.description: Prof. Yangsiyu Lu invited Prof. Jean-Marc Tallon, Research Professor at the French National Centre for Scientific Research (CNRS) and Professor at the Paris School of Economics, to visit HKUST(GZ) through the university’s Cross-disciplinary Research Funding for Visiting Scholars program (CRFVS).

item.title: Academic Seminar
item.description: Professor Jean-Marc Tallon from Paris School of Economics was invited to give a seminar titled “Sharing Model Uncertainty.”
